features.rationale: Turn the stepped hollow body, including the exterior cone, short precision bore land, relief and ball-gauged rear taper.
features.justification: The smaller bore land is between the 1.500 shoulder and the shoulder 4.12 from the right end; the 2.484 relief continues rightward from there. This corrects the extraction's description of the 4.12 shoulder as the front of the precision land. The phantom .500 balls touch the right end plane, and their inner separation is 1.9734. The taper end radius is (D017+D028)/2+(D028/2)*(sec(15 degrees)+tan(15 degrees)). Numeric factors 1.303225372841206 and 0.2679491924311227 are respectively sec(D009)+tan(D009) and tan(D009), calculated from the printed 15-degree callout, not additional dimensions. The 3.1250 REF diameter is only a check.

This complete nominal plan contains unresolved edge treatments and an unsupported oblique radial hole. It is not a manufacturing-release model until those items are addressed. F020 must communicate with F021 in the completed geometry.
D004 and D014 have equal nominal values but different tolerances and meanings and remain separate references.
Preserve the Cartesian hole coordinates rather than substituting exact circular arrays for either six-hole arrangement.
The rear taper uses the .500-ball gauge and 15-degree angle. Phantom inspection balls are not part geometry.
Review the precision-land/relief shoulder association and the nominal recess-C crown against a clearer original before release; the interpretations are explicitly recorded.
Threads are cosmetic. Proprietary hole suffixes A and B, TIR/position requirements, surface textures and finish codes require the referenced IE standards for manufacturing interpretation.
